# qik nexus demote — retreat stage

Use `mcp_qik-mcp_nexus_demote` or CLI:

```bash
qik nexus demote <CR_ID>
```

Stage regression: `staged → pi → backlog → idea`

Use this to pull a staged item back into PI if it was promoted prematurely.
